accounting_unit: one GPU allocated for one minute
policy_note: Current mode is non-commercial research and development in the GitHub development environment, not a commercial production service. Provider terms must permit this specific current use. Commercial-use rights are not a qualification requirement now. Free/no-card eligibility, automation, workload compatibility, data handling, actual allocation, fresh capacity, and reliability still require evidence. Switching to commercial production requires requalification. Sensitive or private prompts must not be sent to unapproved community-operated providers.

providers.name: huggingface_zerogpu
providers.display_name: Hugging Face ZeroGPU — approved Space path only

official_sources.supports: Free personal accounts in good standing, with verified email and account age over 30 days, can host up to two ZeroGPU Spaces. The documented free quota is 5 GPU-minutes per account per day and resets 24 hours after first usage. Access is shared and Space/Gradio-oriented.

advertised.notes: 150 is 5 minutes/day multiplied by a 30-day normalization; it is not account-confirmed or queue-adjusted usable capacity and is never counted toward the target.

notes: A real Space test must use an AstroCrown-owned workload.
The user has not authorized prompts to community-operated volunteer GPUs; do not substitute community Spaces for an approved deployment.

providers.name: lightning_ai

official_sources.supports: The official pricing page advertises up to 80 free GPU hours to start with no credit card; the actual GPU hours vary by selected GPU pricing. The free tier advertises up to 30 credits. Phone verification is required to receive the free GPU-hour allocation according to the official AI Studio guide. The free CPU Studio needs restart every four hours and is not a continuously hot GPU service.
The AI Studio guide says phone verification is required to receive up to 80 free GPU hours, and says the service may be unavailable in some countries.

advertised.notes: The public headline is up to 80 free GPU hours to start, with GPU-specific values varying by price and phone verification required. It is not an account-observed balance or a guaranteed recurring monthly GPU-minute allowance; no GPU-minute value is counted until account details and a real allocation are verified.

notes: Potential starting GPU capacity worth testing for R&D, subject to phone verification, account conditions, selected GPU pricing and current allowance.
This is not yet a verified recurring contribution to the 86,400 GPU-minute/month target.
The free CPU Studio's four-hour restart behavior does not itself establish GPU availability or reliability.

Included dollar balances are not GPU-minutes or a fixed GPU-time entitlement.
